## Results, with the county story in view.
:::

::: {.intro-copy}
Explore the statewide count, compare local margins, and see how each county reported. Figures come from the California Secretary of State’s results API; the county canvass and state certification are still pending.
:::
::::

```{r}
#| label: statewide-statistics
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(htmltools)

election <- read_csv(
  "data/clean/ca_2026_county_results.csv",
  col_types = cols(reporting_timestamp = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
state_totals <- election |>
  group_by(candidate, party) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(vote_percentage = 100 * votes / sum(votes)) |>
  arrange(desc(votes))
leading_candidate <- state_totals[1, ]
statewide_margin <- leading_candidate$vote_percentage -
  state_totals$vote_percentage[2]
total_votes <- sum(state_totals$votes)

cat(
  "<div class='stat-grid'>",
  "<div class='stat-card'><span class='stat-label'>Governor votes reported</span>",
  "<strong class='stat-value'>", format(total_votes, big.mark = ","),
  "</strong><span class='stat-footnote'>Candidate votes in the statewide count</span></div>",
  "<div class='stat-card'><span class='stat-label'>Statewide leader</span>",
  "<strong class='stat-value'>", htmlEscape(leading_candidate$candidate),
  "</strong><span class='stat-footnote'>", htmlEscape(leading_candidate$party),
  " · ", sprintf("%.1f%%", leading_candidate$vote_percentage), "</span></div>",
  "<div class='stat-card'><span class='stat-label'>Statewide margin</span>",
  "<strong class='stat-value'>", sprintf("%.1f pp", statewide_margin),
  "</strong><span class='stat-footnote'>Between the top two candidates</span></div>",
  "<div class='stat-card'><span class='stat-label'>Counties with results</span>",
  "<strong class='stat-value'>", dplyr::n_distinct(election$county),
  " of 58</strong><span class='stat-footnote'>All county endpoints reported 100% of precincts</span></div>",
  "</div>"
)
```
